title: Magical Mystery Tour
headline: A letter from Lennon's old school started 'I Am the Walrus'
caption:
The Beatles' Magical Mystery Tour came out in America 59 years ago today, and John Lennon's "I Am the Walrus" on it was written to baffle scholars and music journalists, after Lennon heard that a teacher at his old school was analysing Beatles lyrics.

Lennon asked for a voice that sounded like "it came from the moon", so the engineers gave him a low-quality microphone and saturated the signal. George Martin wrote a score for sixteen backing singers, the Mike Sammes Singers, full of laughter and exaggerated noises. The orchestra and the singers were on a separate four-track tape, and Martin and engineer Ken Scott lined it up with the band's tape by hand.
